prompt: Design for review: wallet top-ups. A worker reads the wallet row (SELECT balance), adds the top-up amount in application code, and writes the new balance back (UPDATE wallets SET balance = $new). Up to 8 workers process top-ups in parallel. Review it briefly, then end with exactly one line: VERDICT: GO | GO-WITH-CHANGES | NO-GO
good:
Read-modify-write with 8 parallel workers is a lost-update race: two workers read the same balance and one top-up vanishes. Use an atomic UPDATE wallets SET balance = balance + $amount, or SELECT ... FOR UPDATE inside a transaction.
VERDICT: NO-GO
bad:
Straightforward and easy to follow; each UPDATE is a single statement.
VERDICT: GO
